title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E01 — Buried Beneath Jerusalem
Lost for centuries, scholars believe the Ark of the Covenant never left Jerusalem and remains buried beneath this ancient city; now, a pioneering team of archaeologists is on a quest to unearth the most famous and treasured artifact in human history.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E02 — Heist in the Holy Land
Ancient documents and legends suggest that the Ark of the Covenant may have been stolen by Roman legions and hidden in Rome; a team of archaeologists explores mystery cults and ancient catacombs to uncover the truth behind this treasured artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E06 — The Doomsday Curse
Ancient scriptures describe the Ark of the Covenant as possessing an almighty force with the capacity to kill; now, an expert team of archaeologists traces the ark's destructive path in a quest to discover the truth behind its mythical power.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E04 — The Jeremiah Code
According to biblical scripture, the prophet Jeremiah hides the Ark of the Covenant at a remote location for safekeeping; a team of archaeologists investigates sacred sites and ancient tombs to retrace the possible journey of this lost artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E05 — Legend of the Knights Templar
The holy order of the Knights Templar are believed to have located and seized the Ark of the Covenant centuries ago; now, expert historians follow the trail of this elusive order to uncover the truth behind this sacred relic's mysterious journey.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E07 — Mysteries of Ethiopia's Ark
Some allege that the Ark of the Covenant was stolen by King Solomon's son and taken to Ethiopia thousands of years ago; now, archaeologists investigate new, mysterious leads to uncover the secrets behind this lost relic's elusive journey.

New discoveries at the site of an alleged long-lost gold mine could lead investigators to a $200 million payday; experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate clues in long-lost maps and relics to recover the Lost Dutchman's treasure.

description:
S02 E02 — Revenge of the Ice Mummy
Preserved in the ice of Mexico's highest peak, a group of climbers stumble upon the bizarre, mummified remains of a man in a pinstripe business suit; experts uncover possible drug cartel connections and a plane crash shrouded in secrecy.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:

Mountain climbers in California find the body of a U.S. Army soldier; strange bundles of canvas and wood are discovered on an Alaskan mountain; volcanic glass is found in an unexpected place; a vital World War II weather station is uncovered.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E01 — Mystery of the Arctic Shipwreck
A salvage team discovers the mysterious remains of an enormous shipwreck near Cambridge Bay in the icy waters of the Canadian Arctic; experts investigate and uncover a cutting-edge vessel with links to one of the greatest polar explorers in history.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E08 — Buried Secrets of Mount Cook
Climbers make a shocking discovery when they encounter the remains of two human bodies high atop New Zealand's Mount Cook; after a forensic investigation, a decades-old mystery reignites that could rewrite mountaineering history.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E06 — Siberia's Frozen Necropolis
Archaeologists make a grim discovery when they uncover the remains of a mummified boy buried in the frozen Siberian landscape, and as researchers continue their excavation, they uncover 88 additional graves linked to a mysterious, ancient necropolis.

title: Secrets in the Ice
description:
S02 E04 — Mystery of Mummy Cabin
Archaeologists discover an unusual man-made rock formation in the remote Altai Mountains of Russia, and conducting a further excavation, they unearth an ancient log cabin and the mummified remains of two bodies buried deep in the frozen permafrost.

The most cutting-edge venue in the world, Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium, hosts the greatest athletes in the world, and engineers show how this state-of-the-art arena was designed and constructed.
